description_en: Retrieves the KubeConfig configuration for a Service Mesh instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeServiceMeshKubeconfig获取连接服务网格的KubeConfig配置
name: DescribeServiceMeshKubeconfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Service Mesh instance
parameters.name: service_mesh_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to access the instance over an internal network
parameters.name: private_ip_address

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the kubeconfig certificate. The format is YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss
ExpireTime.description_zh: kubeconfig证书的过期时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss

Kubeconfig.description_en: The content of the kubeconfig file
Kubeconfig.example: apiVersion: v1 clusters: - cluster:     server: https://47.110.xx.xx:6443     certificate-authority-data: ****
